name: ACR Radiation Oncology In-Training Exam and Red Journal Gray Zone Cases Benchmark
description: This benchmark evaluates the performance of large language models, specifically ChatGPT-4, on specialized radiation oncology knowledge and clinical decision-making using the American College of Radiology (ACR) radiation oncology in-training exam and complex clinical cases from the Red Journal Gray Zone collection.
reputation: A small, specialized medical benchmark that has been cited for probing LLM performance in radiation oncology, but it is not yet a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Benchmark includes 300 multiple-choice questions from the TXIT exam and 15 complex clinical cases; highlights strengths and weaknesses of ChatGPT-4 in radiation oncology domains and clinical care paths.
